title: wsutil: Don't allow profile name shenanigans
description:
Don't allow breaking out of the personal or global profiles directory
    due to profile names with "." or "..". Avoid saying that profiles with
    those sort of bogus names exist (we could fall back to the default
    directory, but let's not encourage that sort of thing.) Especially make
    sure we don't delete the personal configuration directory or the
    profiles/ directory inside that. (Also handle the case where NULL is
    somehow passed to it, which it isn't by any users currently, but it
    should neither crash nor delete the directory in that case; resetting
    as if the "Default" string were passed should be ok.)
    
Consolidate some code. Avoid copying the no profile personal
    configuration directory string except on error in reset_default_profile.
    Avoid truncating files away in copy_file_binary_mode if the from
    and to paths point to the same file already.
    
Fix #21538
    
Thanks to Yazan Balawneh for the report
